text:
**The evidence does not establish whether a forest protection rule was violated.** It shows a 0.6-hectare tree-cover loss in 2022, of which 0.5 hectares overlaps native forest on Uruguay’s 2021 forest map. The entire loss area was mapped as forest in the 2020 JRC reference.

A further 0.2 hectares of loss occurred in patches below the tool’s 0.5-hectare event threshold and was not counted as an event.

Determining compliance requires checking the applicable protection rules, the cause of the loss, and whether any required authorization was granted.
